requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
There should be a dedicated phone line for direct communication with clinic staff.
There should be a feature to flag urgent appointments for timely responses.
Repeat prescription requests should be submitted online in a secure manner.
There must be a review process for repeat prescription requests before approval.
Test results should be securely displayed only after clinician authorization.
There must be a clear process for managing the flow of information regarding test results.
The portal must ensure patient safety and secure handling of personal information.
The system must be user-friendly for all patients, especially older ones.
